metrics.definitions: Task denominators include blocked/error cases. Submetrics count applicable recorded turn expectations; cases without turn records are explicitly unmeasured, never passed. Tool selection counts validated execution attempts; proposal scores use model proposals only, excluding paths with no proposal. Arguments count expected selectors, attribution counts evidence checks, numeric attribution is the figure/value subset. Scores reflect bounded corpus oracles, not general semantic accuracy. Phase spans are nested and must not be summed.

modelArtifacts.provenance: Configured files/artifact hashes; actual served process not attested by this evaluator.

limitations: Old corpora explicitly retain legacy-v1 fixtures and their known measure blind spot; the stronger 11-case corpus has a separate version/denominator and immutable-v2 fixtures.
Structured scope requests/continuations and explicit partial inspection can bypass inference. Scores measure application handling, not isolated model accuracy.
Financial adapters/formatters retain their existing contracts; the new typed boundary covers request, clarification and presentation metadata, not a complete domain-model migration.
The existing live trade base-NPV unit error and missing positive IR/vega/command capabilities remain open; no server/data/broker repair.
New single-formatter render spans have different sampling from the old probing chain; timings are descriptive and must not be advertised as a before/after latency benchmark.
Native Linux NVIDIA/hosted/least-privilege security and remote CI dispatch remain unverified.
